verdict.rationale: Extend's pricing page lists 'BYOC (your VPC) and Hybrid deployments', and its compliance docs refer to 'all deployment options'. That is a first-party claim that the core platform can run inside the customer's own cloud. However, the claim is only a pricing-page bullet with no deployment documentation or corroboration, and it appears to be a sales-tier option rather than a general self-host path. The open-source UI kit is a separate front-end library, not the core product, so it earns no credit. Missing for 10: self-hosting or BYOC installation docs, clarity on which tier includes it, on-prem/air-gapped options, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: Extend maintains enterprise-grade security controls across all deployment options.
